name: Voxel Gradient Calculation
definition: A pre-processing step using the Sobel operator to detect edges within the volume and compute gradients. Gradient magnitude modulates voxel opacity to hide homogeneous regions, and gradient direction is used for shading.
summary: Voxel gradient calculation modulates opacity and shading in ray-casting to highlight boundaries and hide homogeneous regions, distinguishing itself by its specific application to volume rendering pipelines rather than general image processing.
